affected.note: Customers who paid by credit card on suruga-ya.jp between 2025-07-23 12:50 and 2025-08-08: 30,431 card records belonging to 29,932 customers. Card number, expiry date and security code plus name, address, phone number and email address may have leaked.

summary.en: Suruga-ya found on 2025-08-04 that the payment page JavaScript of its suruga-ya.jp shopping site had been tampered with via a vulnerability in a monitoring tool. A forensic investigation found that card and personal data of 29,932 customers (30,431 cards) may have leaked.
summary.ja: 駿河屋は2025年8月4日、通販サイト「駿河屋.JP」で監視ツールの脆弱性を突かれ決済ページのJavaScriptが改ざんされていたことを検知した。フォレンジック調査の結果、29,932名分（クレジットカード30,431件）のカード情報と個人情報が漏洩した可能性があると公表した。
